scripts.build: prisma generate --schema=../../prisma/schema.prisma && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('public')) fs.cpSync('public', 'dist/public', {recursive: true}); if(fs.existsSync('public/storage')) fs.cpSync('public/storage', 'dist/storage', {recursive: true});"
scripts.vercel-build: prisma generate --schema=../../prisma/schema.prisma && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('public')) fs.cpSync('public', 'dist/public', {recursive: true}); if(fs.existsSync('public/storage')) fs.cpSync('public/storage', 'dist/storage', {recursive: true});"
